name: pipe-runner
description: Isometric platformer game - Pipe Runner. A free, open-source game inspired by classic Game Boy platformers.

scripts.build:web: mkdir -p build/web && cp -r index.html src build/web/ && echo 'Web build ready in build/web/'
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:android
scripts.deploy:gh: npm run build:web && echo 'Deploy build/web/ to gh-pages branch'
